description: This file implements a PermissionManager for macOS applications, providing methods to check and request various system permissions such as location, notifications, camera, microphone, and screen recording, as well as handling permission status monitoring and system settings navigation.

classes.name: LocationPermissionRequester
classes.description: Singleton class managing location permission requests with delegate callbacks and continuation-based async handling.

classes.name: PermissionMonitor
classes.description: Observable class that monitors permission statuses, providing registration and periodic status refresh capabilities.

classes.name: AppleScriptPermission
classes.description: Helper class for checking and requesting automation permissions via AppleScript.

classes.name: ScreenRecordingProbe
classes.description: Provides methods for checking and requesting screen recording permissions on macOS 10.15+.

methods.name: isLocationAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the location authorization status meets the 'always' requirement.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Ensures the specified capabilities are granted, returning a dictionary of results.

methods.name: ensureCapability
methods.description: Checks and requests a specific capability interactively if needed.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status (granted or not) for all capabilities.
